svg.title: Three enlarged real candidates compared against a stated purpose
svg.desc: Three enlarged real candidates compared against a stated purpose. Cropped three upright frames from the public-domain contact sheet without retouching or rotation. Original frame numbers retained in new labels. Selection is an editorial interpretation, not an archival preference. Light editorial presentation: fixed white paper, regular Helvetica labels, fine charcoal lines and restrained green accents.
